name: Claude - Call With Skills
description: Anthropic-only webhook with Files API for generating .docx, .xlsx files

parameters.content:
## Claude - Call With Skills (Anthropic Skills API)

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/claude-call-with-skills

**Description:** Appel Claude avec Skills API pour générer des documents (.docx, .xlsx, .pptx, etc.)

**InputSchema:**
```json
{
  "required": ["api_key", "messages", "container"],
  "properties": {
    "api_key": { "type": "string", "description": "Anthropic API key (REQUIRED)" },
    "model": { "type": "string", "default": "claude-sonnet-4-20250514" },
    "betas": { "type": "array", "default": ["code-execution-2025-08-25", "skills-2025-10-02"] },
    "system": { "type": "string" },
    "messages": { "type": "array" },
    "max_tokens": { "type": "integer", "default": 16000 },
    "container": {
      "skills": [{ "type": "anthropic", "skill_id": "docx|xlsx|pptx|pdf", "version": "latest" }]
    },
    "tools": { "type": "array", "description": "code_execution tool auto-added" },
    "metadata": { "type": "object" }
  }
}
```

**Skills disponibles:**
- `docx` : Génère .docx (Word)
- `xlsx` : Génère .xlsx (Excel)
- `pptx` : Génère .pptx (PowerPoint)
- `pdf` : Génère .pdf

**Note:** Le tool code_execution est automatiquement ajouté.

**ANTHROPIC ONLY** - Les Skills sont spécifiques à Anthropic.
